retired.name: Regular
retired.why: Counts logins, which a relog inflates. Devoted counts the days

retired.name: Longstanding
retired.why: Rises without playing. Seasoned counts the weeks with play

retired.name: Full House
retired.why: Nearly every dungeon run is a group of five, so it counted Delver's runs again

retired.name: Scout
retired.why: Elite creatures stand beside every road; the count rose without the player doing anything

retired.name: Witness
retired.why: Vanquisher and Conqueror count the bosses killed; seeing one adds nothing

retired.name: Scavenger
retired.why: Grey items are a by-product of Looter. Lucky, Rare Find and Jackpot cover the drops worth noticing

retired.name: Practised
retired.why: A skill-up is a rank gained, which Artisan already sums

retired.name: Battle Medic
retired.why: Kills are not what a healer is for, and Slayer counts them

retired.name: Frontliner
retired.why: Slayer counts the same kills

retired.name: First to Fall
retired.why: Fallen counts the same deaths
